content: Rifampin reduces the effectiveness or concentration of ulipristal by inducing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. It is recommended to avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of upadacitinib by enhancing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers or consider alternative treatments. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of valbenazine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Concomitant use is not recommended; alternative drugs should be considered. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of vardenafil by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of velpatasvir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. Rifampin decreases vemurafenib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of venetoclax by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A inducers. Consider alternative treatments with agents that have less CYP3A induction. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of verapamil by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of vonoprazan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin decreases vorapaxar levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of voriconazole by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of voxilaprevir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Avoid using voxilaprevir and rifampin together. Rifampin is contraindicated when coadministered with the combination of sofosbuvir/velpatasvir/voxilaprevir, as per prescribing information. Rifampin reduces zanubrutinib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers or use an alternative drug. Rifampin increases the levels or effects of intranasal zavegepant through mechanisms involving OATP1B3 inhibition. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin decreases zuranolone levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin reduces abiraterone levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. If unavoidable, increase abiraterone dosage frequency from once daily to twice daily. Rifampin decreases alfentanil levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces alfuzosin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases alosetron levels by inducing both CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Aluminum hydroxide reduces rifampin absorption, likely by altering gastrointestinal conditions. Administer rifampin at least 1 hour before antacids to avoid reduced efficacy. Magnesium carbonate and magnesium trisilicate also reduce rifampin absorption. Administer rifampin at least 1 hour before antacids to maintain therapeutic levels. Rifampin decreases ambrisentan levels by inducing CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Initial coadministration may transiently increase ambrisentan AUC, but this effect diminishes by day 7. Rifampin reduces amikacin levels by affecting P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter activity. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases amitriptyline levels by inducing CYP2C19, CYP3A4 metabolism, and P-glycoprotein activity. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces amlodipine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases amobarbital levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces antipyrine levels by inducing CYP1A2 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Apalutamide decreases rifampin levels by increasing its elimination. Use caution and monitor closely. Apalutamide weakly induces OATP1B1, potentially reducing systemic exposure of OATP1B1 substrates. Rifampin decreases armodafinil levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein activity. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces artesunate levels by increasing its metabolism, potentially decreasing the AUC and peak plasma concentration of its active metabolite (DHA). Monitor for reduced efficacy. Rifampin decreases asenapine levels by inducing CYP1A2 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces atogepant levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Atogepant dosage adjustments may be necessary when coadministered with OATP inhibitors. Rifampin decreases atorvastatin levels by affecting P-glycoprotein activity. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces atovaquone levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases avanafil levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor patients with erectile dysfunction for reduced effectiveness. Rifampin reduces avatrombopag levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. For ITP treatment, increase avatrombopag starting dose when coadministered with moderate or strong dual CYP2C9/3A4 inducers. Azithromycin increases rifampin levels by affecting P-glycoprotein activity. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases bazedoxifene/conjugated estrogens levels by affecting P-glycoprotein activity. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces belumosudil levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Increase belumosudil dosage to 200 mg PO BID when coadministered with strong CYP3A inducers. Rifampin decreases bendamustine levels by inducing CYP1A2 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Active metabolite concentrations may increase. Rifampin reduces benzhydrocodone/acetaminophen levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Discontinuation of CYP3A4 inducers may increase hydrocodone plasma concentrations, potentially causing fatal respiratory depression. Rifampin decreases berotralstat levels by affecting P-glycoprotein activity. Use caution and monitor closely. Monitor or titrate P-gp substrate doses if coadministered. Rifampin reduces bexagliflozin levels by inducing UGT1A9 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Consider adding another antihyperglycemic agent for additional glycemic control. Rifampin decreases bexarotene levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces bortezomib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases bosentan levels by inducing CYP2C9/10 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Bosutinib increases rifampin levels by affecting P-glycoprotein activity. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces brentuximab vedotin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases brexpiprazole levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Double the brexpiprazole dose over 1–2 weeks if coadministered with a strong CYP3A4 inducer. Rifampin reduces brivaracetam levels by inducing CYP2C19 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Increase brivaracetam dosage up to 100% (double the dose) during concomitant rifampin treatment. Rifampin decreases bromocriptine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces budesonide levels by affecting P-glycoprotein activity. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases buprenorphine levels (including buccal, subdermal implant, transdermal, and long-acting injection forms) by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Adjust buprenorphine dosage as needed and monitor for withdrawal symptoms or respiratory depression. Rifampin reduces bupropion levels by inducing CYP2B6 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases butabarbital and butalbital levels by increasing their metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces cabazitaxel levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. Rifampin decreases calcifediol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Drugs that stimulate microsomal hydroxylation reduce calcifediol half-life. Rifampin reduces calcitriol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Calcium carbonate reduces rifampin absorption. Administer rifampin at least 1 hour before antacids to maintain therapeutic levels. Rifampin decreases canagliflozin levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. For patients with eGFR <73 mL/min/1.73 m², consider alternative antihyperglycemic agents. Rifampin reduces cannabidiol levels by inducing CYP3A4 and CYP2B6 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Adjust dosages of CYP2B6 substrates as clinically appropriate. Rifampin decreases carvedilol levels by inducing CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely.
